description: Utility module for manipulating torch Graph objects and TorchScript, including classes and functions for creating and managing ONNX nodes within Torch's internal graph representation.

classes.name: GraphContext
classes.description: Holds context for constructing and manipulating torch._C.Graph objects, including methods for creating ONNX operators and managing graph state.

methods.name: add_op_with_blocks
methods.description: Creates an ONNX operator with specified inputs, attributes, and sub-blocks, returning output values, new contexts, and the node.

methods.name: parse_node_kind
methods.description: Parses a node kind string into domain and operator name components.

methods.name: is_aten
methods.description: Checks if a given domain string corresponds to the 'aten' domain.

methods.name: is_prim
methods.description: Checks if a given domain string corresponds to the 'prim' domain.

methods.name: is_onnx
methods.description: Checks if a given domain string corresponds to the 'onnx' domain.
